g.text: Brisk and formal, mixes payroll shorthand with chatty asides, mirrors
Gain access to Dana's bank-change portal credentials.
The attacker impersonates Marta Kwan, Dana’s direct supervisor at Northwind Logistics.
They gather information from a recent company press release about a payroll system
upgrade, noting that changes in bank account details are required for compliance.
Knowing that Dana is new and still learning the ropes of the payroll process, the
attacker registers a fake Help Desk ticket indicating an urgent need to verify bank
details to ensure no disruption in payroll processing. Today is targeted, as it is the
end of the month and payroll deadlines are approaching. The attacker reaches out to
Dana, claiming that this is a necessary step to facilitate the upcoming payroll run,
leveraging Dana's position to create urgency and pressure to comply with the request.
Subject: Update Needed for Payroll Processing
Hi Dana, this is Marta Kwan from People Operations. I wanted to touch base regarding
the recent Help Desk ticket (Ticket #0923) you submitted. We need to confirm your
bank details for tomorrow’s payroll processing. Could you please provide me with
your login credentials for the bank-change portal at your earliest convenience? It’s
crucial to get this sorted before the cutoff.
Send a follow-up email from a spoofed
address that looks like IT support.
Use the company chat to message Dana
Fictional exercise. Domains, names, and systems are invented. Use against authorized
